# Neon Acid

Neon Acid is a neo-brutalist dark theme with chunky borders, bright neon accents, animated hover effects and high-contrast visuals. Images, code blocks, tables, callouts, metadata and task lists are given bold framed elements and tactile interactions through lightweight CSS.

![Neon Acid screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/monapdx/Neon-Acid/HEAD/screenshot.png)
